text.jp: さっさと終わらせてやる
text.official_en: I’ll send you packin’ in no time.
I’m the master of my destiny!

text.jp: わたくし、ブチ切れますわよ！
text.official_en: You’re making me lose my temper, dear!
text.real_en: I'm about to lose my temper!

text.jp: 光は我らとともにある
text.official_en: The light will always be with us.

text.real_en: This is the beginning of ruin.

text.jp: 王サマの力見せてやるよ！
text.official_en: I’ll show you what a king can do!
I’ll put an end to this!
Light and darkness are my strength.
